sentences.text:
The offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 498A, 323, 354 r/w 34 IPC.
2.

According to the petitioners, the defacto complainant and the petitioners are residing at Kakkanad and therefore, they prayed for transferring the above case to the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kakkanad.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kakkanad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Though notice was served on the 3 rd respondent/defacto complainant through the SHO,
Thirkkakkara Police Station, she did not turn up.
The learned Public Prosecutor has not opposed the prayer in this petition.
4. Since according to the petitioners, the petitioners and the defacto complainant are residing at Kakkanad and though notice was served on the defacto complaint, she did not turn up.
I hold that this case can be transferred from the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court- V, Kozhikode to the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kakkanad.
